bosses.name: Kurinnaxx
bosses.general: Mortal Wound stacks on the tank, Sand Traps appear under players (move off them), he enrages at 30%.
bosses.tank: Two tanks swap at about 5 Mortal Wound stacks.
bosses.healer: Heal ahead of the mortal wounds.
bosses.dps: Step off the sand traps; burn him in the enrage.

bosses.name: General Rajaxx
bosses.general: Seven waves of Qiraji led by captains, then Rajaxx: Thundercrash halves everyone's health, Disarm.
bosses.tank: Gather each wave on you; captains on their own tank.
bosses.dps: Area attacks on the waves, the captain of each wave first.

bosses.name: Moam
bosses.general: Drains mana from players to fill his own; at full mana he explodes. Every so often he turns to stone and three Mana Fiends spawn.
bosses.healer: Drain Moam's mana: Viper Sting, Mana Burn, Drain Mana.
bosses.dps: Burn him fast; kill the Mana Fiends when he's stone.

bosses.name: Buru the Gorger
bosses.general: Fixates on a player and chases them: kite him over the eggs and blow them up near him. At 20% he hardens and takes more damage.
bosses.tank: No real tank: the fixated player runs him over eggs.
bosses.healer: Heal the egg blasts and the fixated player.
bosses.dps: Break eggs when Buru is on them; burn him at 20%.

bosses.name: Ayamiss the Hunter
bosses.general: Flies at first: Stinger Spray, Poison Stinger, and paralyzes a player on the altar where larvae come to eat them. Lands at 70%.
bosses.tank: Pick her up when she lands.
bosses.healer: Cure poison; heal the sacrificed player.
bosses.dps: Kill the larvae before they reach the altar; ranged on her while she flies.

bosses.name: Ossirian the Unscarred
bosses.general: Immune to everything until he stands by a crystal: each crystal makes him weak to one school for a while. Tornadoes roam; War Stomp, Curse of Tongues.
bosses.tank: Drag him to the next crystal before the weakness ends.
bosses.dps: Use the school the crystal opens; stay away from the tornadoes.

trash.name: Obsidian Destroyer
trash.general: Drains mana from players; at full mana it Purges: 3500 damage and a stun to everyone within 40 yards. Keep its mana low.
trash.healer: Priests Mana Burn it when the group is healthy.
trash.dps: Warlocks Drain Mana, hunters Viper Sting it; kill it fast.

trash.name: Anubisath Guardian
trash.general: Each has random powers: Plague (run away), Shadow Storm, Thunderclap, Meteor or summoned warriors; it explodes at 10%.
trash.tank: Tank it away from the group.
trash.dps: Run away with Plague; leave it when it explodes.

trash.name: Flesh Hunter
trash.general: Consume swallows a player for a while; Poison Bolt.
trash.healer: Heal the swallowed player when it spits them out; cure poison.
trash.dps: Kill it to free the player.
